name: personUrl
label: Person URL
help: New InMail recipient: Recruiter profile URL. A mix with Thread ID is refused by Core.

name: threadId
label: Thread ID
help: Reply thread ID. A mix with Person URL or Subject is refused by Core.

name: messageSubject
label: Message Subject
help: New InMail subject, 1–200 characters, one line; required with Person URL. A mix with Thread ID is refused by Core.

name: allowPaidCredit
label: Allow Paid Credit
help: A paid InMail credit is spent only when this is true. Turn on Allow Paid Credit only when the user has explicitly approved spending a paid InMail credit on this message; on inMailCreditRequired, ask the user instead of retrying with Allow Paid Credit on.
